fix.explanation: The match is at the Fondation Martin Bodmer, Cologny, Geneva, Switzerland: opening ceremony on 22 November, first game on 24 November and tie-breaks (if needed) on 12 December 2026, with a prize fund of USD 2.5 million over 14 classical games.
